name: musaddiqr-motion
description: Two 26s motion pieces for musaddiqr.com, rendered with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render projects out/projects.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 && remotion render agents out/agents.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 && remotion still projects out/projects-poster.jpg --frame=130 && remotion still agents out/agents-poster.jpg --frame=130
